collaboration.example_en: The two classes finished the mural through real collaboration.
collaboration.example_zh: 两个班靠真正的合作完成了那幅壁画。

collection.example_en: This collection of ghost stories is the favourite book in our class.
collection.example_zh: 这本鬼故事合集是我们班最喜欢的书。

college.example_en: My sister moved into college housing the week after graduation.
college.example_zh: 姐姐毕业后的那个星期搬进了大学宿舍。

colour.example_en: The art room walls change colour whenever a new show goes up.
colour.example_zh: 每次有新展览，美术教室的墙就会换颜色。

column.example_en: Mum writes a cooking column for the local Sunday paper.
column.example_zh: 妈妈为当地的星期日报写美食专栏。

comedy.example_en: We laughed all through the comedy that the drama club put on.
comedy.example_zh: 戏剧社演的那出喜剧，我们从头笑到尾。

comfort.example_en: A warm blanket and hot tea brought comfort after the cold game.
comfort.example_zh: 一场寒冷的比赛之后，暖毯子和热茶带来了安慰。

command.example_en: At the coach's command, every runner dropped to the track.
command.example_zh: 教练一声命令，所有选手都趴到了跑道上。

comment.example_en: Ms Lee wrote one kind comment beside my messy diagram.
comment.example_zh: 李老师在我凌乱的图旁边写了一句善意的评论。

committee.example_en: The sports committee moved the final to the indoor court.
committee.example_zh: 体育委员会把决赛改到了室内球场。

communication.example_en: Poor communication made the relay team drop the baton twice.
communication.example_zh: 交流没做好，接力队两次把接力棒掉在了地上。

community.example_en: Our community opened a small library in the old post office.
community.example_zh: 我们社区在旧邮局里开了一间小图书馆。

company.example_en: Dad's company donated footballs to every class in our grade.
company.example_zh: 爸爸的公司给我们年级每个班捐赠了足球。

comparison.example_en: A quick comparison showed the bus pass costs less than daily tickets.
comparison.example_zh: 简单一比较就发现，公交月票比每天买票更便宜。

complaint.example_en: I filed a complaint because the locker room had no hot water.
complaint.example_zh: 更衣室没有热水，我为此提交了投诉。

component.example_en: The missing component was a tiny screw from the robot's arm.
component.example_zh: 缺少的那个组成部分是机器人手臂上的一颗小螺丝。

computer.example_en: The library computer crashed while I was printing my essay.
computer.example_zh: 我正在打印作文时，图书馆的电脑死机了。

concentration.example_en: A buzzing phone ruined my concentration halfway through the exam.
concentration.example_zh: 手机嗡嗡响，考试做到一半我就没法集中了。

concert.example_en: My violin teacher saved me a seat at her evening concert.
concert.example_zh: 小提琴老师在她的晚场音乐会上给我留了座位。

conference.example_en: Parents packed the hall for a conference on school meals.
conference.example_zh: 家长们挤满礼堂，来参加关于学校餐食的会议。

confidence.example_en: Winning the debate gave Nora new confidence in speaking aloud.
confidence.example_zh: 赢下辩论后，诺拉当众说话有了新的信心。

confusion.example_en: Two similar maps caused confusion about which bus to take.
confusion.example_zh: 两张相似的地图造成了混乱，大家不知道该坐哪路车。

consideration.example_en: After careful consideration, we chose the smaller, quieter dog.
consideration.example_zh: 仔细考虑之后，我们选了那只更小、更安静的狗。

construction.example_en: Construction beside the playground made it hard to hear the teacher.
construction.example_zh: 操场旁边在施工，我们很难听清老师的话。

consultant.example_en: A sleep consultant told my cousin to put his phone away at night.
consultant.example_zh: 一位睡眠顾问让我表哥晚上把手机收起来。

consultation.example_en: A short consultation with the nurse settled my worry about the rash.
consultation.example_zh: 向护士简短请教之后，我对那片皮疹就不担心了。

consumer.example_en: Each consumer who tasted the new juice wrote a score on the card.
consumer.example_zh: 每位品尝新果汁的消费者都在卡片上写了分数。

consumption.example_en: Juice consumption in our canteen doubles when the weather is hot.
consumption.example_zh: 天气一热，我们食堂的果汁消费就会翻倍。

content.example_en: The content of the note on the fridge surprised the whole family.
content.example_zh: 冰箱上那张便条的内容让全家人都吃了一惊。

context.example_en: The joke only makes sense if you know the context from yesterday.
context.example_zh: 只有知道昨天的上下文，这个笑话才讲得通。

contract.example_en: Dad read every line of the contract before he signed his name.
contract.example_zh: 爸爸签名之前，把合同的每一行都读过了。

contractor.example_en: The contractor replaced the broken gym windows over the weekend.
contractor.example_zh: 承包商在周末换掉了体育馆破损的窗户。

contribution.example_en: Our class's contribution of rice and noodles filled two large boxes.
contribution.example_zh: 我们班捐助的大米和面条装满了两个大箱子。

control.example_en: She lost control of the kite when a sudden gust hit the field.
control.example_zh: 突然一阵风刮过场地，她控制不住风筝了。

conversation.example_en: Their conversation about the match lasted the whole bus ride home.
conversation.example_zh: 他们关于那场比赛的对话持续了整个回家的车程。

cooking.example_en: The smell of Mum's cooking pulled us into the kitchen at once.
cooking.example_zh: 妈妈烹饪的香味一下子把我们吸引进了厨房。

copy.example_en: The office made an extra copy of my form for the school file.
copy.example_zh: 办公室多做了一份我的表格副本，放进学校档案。

copyright.example_en: The copyright page says we may not photocopy the whole chapter.
copyright.example_zh: 版权页写明我们不可以复印整个章节。

corner.example_en: We waited at the corner until the rain slowed to a drizzle.
corner.example_zh: 我们在拐角等到雨势变成了毛毛雨。

cost.example_en: The cost of new football boots was more than I had saved.
cost.example_zh: 新足球鞋的花费比我攒下的钱还多。

council.example_en: The town council agreed to repair the bridge before winter.
council.example_zh: 镇理事会同意在入冬之前修好那座桥。

councillor.example_en: A councillor came to ask which playground we use most.
councillor.example_zh: 一位议员来问我们最常去哪个操场。

country.example_en: Canada is the country my cousin moved to last summer.
country.example_zh: 加拿大是我表姐去年夏天搬去的国家。

countryside.example_en: We cycled through the countryside and stopped to pick blackberries.
countryside.example_zh: 我们骑车穿过乡下，还停下来摘了黑莓。

county.example_en: Our county holds a big fair with races and homemade cakes.
county.example_zh: 我们郡会举办大型集市，有比赛，也有自制蛋糕。

couple.example_en: The couple in front of us shared headphones on the train.
couple.example_zh: 我们前面的那一对在火车上合用一副耳机。

course.example_en: The photography course uses the darkroom behind the art studio.
course.example_zh: 摄影课程使用美术教室后面的暗房。

court.example_en: Rain moved our tennis match onto the indoor court.
court.example_zh: 一下雨，我们的网球赛就改到了室内球场。

cow.example_en: The neighbour's cow pushed her head over the fence towards our apples.
cow.example_zh: 邻居家的奶牛把头伸过篱笆，凑向我们的苹果。

craft.example_en: Knotting bracelets is the craft we practise on rainy club days.
craft.example_zh: 编手链是我们在下雨的社团日练习的手艺。

creation.example_en: The model bridge was the creation of two students in year nine.
creation.example_zh: 这座桥梁模型是九年级两名学生的创造。

credit.example_en: Paying the phone bill on time improved Dad's credit at the bank.
credit.example_zh: 按时交电话费，改善了爸爸在银行的信用。

crew.example_en: The stage crew moved the piano during the interval.
crew.example_zh: 负责舞台的全体人员在中场休息时挪走了钢琴。

crime.example_en: Spraying paint on the school wall is a crime, not a joke.
crime.example_zh: 往学校墙上喷漆是罪行，不是开玩笑。

crisis.example_en: A burst pipe created a crisis in the science lab before lunch.
crisis.example_zh: 一根水管爆了，午饭前理科实验室陷入了危机。

crisps.example_en: We split a bag of crisps on the bench after football practice.
crisps.example_zh: 足球训练结束后，我们在长椅上分了一袋炸土豆片。

criterion.example_en: Neat labels were the main criterion for winning the science fair.
criterion.example_zh: 标签工整是科学展评奖的主要标准。

critic.example_en: The food critic returned for a second bowl of the noodle soup.
critic.example_zh: 那位美食批评家又回来喝了第二碗汤面。

crop.example_en: Hail flattened the tomato crop in my uncle's greenhouse.
crop.example_zh: 冰雹砸倒了我叔叔温室里的番茄作物。

cup.example_en: This cup has a crack, so the tea leaks onto the saucer.
cup.example_zh: 这个杯子有裂缝，茶水漏到了碟子上。

curriculum.example_en: First aid was added to the curriculum after the sports day.
curriculum.example_zh: 运动会之后，急救被加进了课程。

curtain.example_en: I opened the curtain and saw frost on the football pitch.
curtain.example_zh: 我拉开窗帘，看见足球场上结了一层霜。

custom.example_en: Sharing mooncakes is a family custom on Mid-Autumn night.
custom.example_zh: 中秋夜分月饼是我们家的习俗。

customer.example_en: The customer asked for a larger size and left the small shirt.
customer.example_zh: 那位顾客要了更大的尺码，把小衬衫留下了。

cycle.example_en: We drew arrows to show how water moves in the water cycle.
cycle.example_zh: 我们画了箭头，说明水在水循环中怎样流动。

dad.example_en: My dad packs an extra bun for me whenever there is a match.
dad.example_zh: 一有比赛，爸爸就会给我多装一个包子。

daddy.example_en: The toddler calls Daddy and holds up his arms to be lifted.
daddy.example_zh: 小孩喊爸爸，并举起胳膊要人抱。

dance.example_en: The lantern dance closed the show and everyone clapped.
dance.example_zh: 灯笼舞蹈为演出收了尾，大家都鼓了掌。

danger.example_en: Black ice on the cycle path put the morning riders in danger.
danger.example_zh: 骑行道上的薄冰让早晨的骑行者陷入了危险。

darling.example_en: Grandma kisses the baby and calls him darling before she leaves.
darling.example_zh: 奶奶离开前会亲亲宝宝，叫他亲爱的。

database.example_en: The nurse checked the database for my vaccination record.
database.example_zh: 护士在数据库里查了我的疫苗接种记录。

date.example_en: Write the date in the top right corner of the test paper.
date.example_zh: 把日期写在试卷的右上角。

daughter.example_en: Their daughter teaches piano to three children from our street.
daughter.example_zh: 他们的女儿教我们这条街上的三个孩子弹钢琴。

day.example_en: On the hottest day, the canteen gave out free ice lollies.
day.example_zh: 最热的那天，食堂免费发了冰棍。

deal.example_en: I got a good deal on a second-hand bike at the school sale.
deal.example_zh: 我在学校义卖上买二手自行车，成交很划算。

death.example_en: The novel ends soon after the death of the loyal dog.
death.example_zh: 那只忠犬死亡后不久，小说就结束了。

debate.example_en: Our debate on school uniforms ran longer than the lunch break.
debate.example_zh: 我们关于校服的辩论比午休时间还长。

debt.example_en: He washed cars all summer to clear the debt for his laptop.
debt.example_zh: 他洗了一夏天的车，才还清买笔记本电脑的债务。

decade.example_en: A decade ago this cafeteria was an empty car park.
decade.example_zh: 十年前，这个食堂还是一片空停车场。

December.example_en: In December our class sells cards to raise money for the shelter.
December.example_zh: 十二月里，我们班卖贺卡，为收容所筹款。

defence.example_en: A strong defence kept the other team from scoring after half-time.
defence.example_zh: 中场休息之后，稳固的防御让对方无法得分。

definition.example_en: I underlined the definition of gravity in my science notes.
definition.example_zh: 我在科学笔记里给重力的定义画了下划线。

degree.example_en: The degree of noise in the canteen makes talking almost impossible.
degree.example_zh: 食堂里噪音的程度大到几乎没法说话。

delegate.example_en: Each year group sent a delegate to plan the charity match.
delegate.example_zh: 每个年级都派了一名代表去策划慈善比赛。

delivery.example_en: The grocery delivery arrived just as we sat down to eat.
delivery.example_zh: 我们刚坐下吃饭，订的食品就送到了。

demand.example_en: Parents made a firm demand for a zebra crossing outside the gate.
demand.example_zh: 家长们坚决要求在校门外画一条斑马线。

Denmark.example_en: My pen friend in Denmark sent a photo of her snowy school.
Denmark.example_zh: 我在丹麦的笔友寄来一张她学校下雪的照片。

deposit.example_en: We left a deposit so the shop would hold the bike until Friday.
deposit.example_zh: 我们付了押金，商店才把自行车留到星期五。

depth.example_en: A painted line shows the depth of the pool at the deep end.
depth.example_zh: 一条彩线显示出泳池深水区的深度。

designer.example_en: The designer tested three logos before the team chose the star.
designer.example_zh: 设计师试了三种队徽，球队才选定了星星那一款。

desire.example_en: His desire to make the team kept him running before breakfast.
desire.example_zh: 他想进队的欲望让他早饭前坚持跑步。

desk.example_en: I found my lost ruler under the desk after everyone had left.
desk.example_zh: 大家都走了以后，我在书桌底下找到了丢失的尺子。

detail.example_en: One detail in the photo showed a cat sitting on the roof.
detail.example_zh: 照片里的一个细节显示屋顶上坐着一只猫。

development.example_en: The development of the new metro has made my bus less crowded.
development.example_zh: 新地铁发展起来以后，我坐的公交没那么挤了。

device.example_en: This small device beeps when the soil in the pot is too dry.
device.example_zh: 花盆里的土太干时，这个小装置就会响。

diet.example_en: The nurse suggested a diet with more vegetables and less fried food.
diet.example_zh: 护士建议饮食里多吃蔬菜，少吃油炸食品。

difficulty.example_en: Long division was the difficulty that stopped most of the class.
difficulty.example_zh: 长除法是拦住班上大多数人的难点。

dining.example_en: Dining at my aunt's house always means too much food and loud talk.
dining.example_zh: 在姨妈家用餐，总是菜多得吃不完，说话也很大声。

dinner.example_en: Dinner was fish and rice, with watermelon for anyone still hungry.
dinner.example_zh: 晚餐是鱼和米饭，没吃饱的人还有西瓜。

director.example_en: The factory director stopped the line when a belt began to smoke.
director.example_zh: 传送带开始冒烟时，工厂主管停下了生产线。

directory.example_en: I found the clinic in the directory pinned beside the office phone.
directory.example_zh: 办公室电话旁钉着名录，我从里面查到了诊所。

disability.example_en: Her disability means she uses a ramp instead of the front steps.
disability.example_zh: 她有残疾，所以走坡道，不走前门的台阶。

disaster.example_en: Forgetting the cakes at home turned the party into a small disaster.
disaster.example_zh: 蛋糕忘在家里，聚会变成了一场小灾祸。

discount.example_en: Students get a discount on museum tickets if they bring an ID card.
discount.example_zh: 学生带证件去博物馆，门票可以打折。

discussion.example_en: A family discussion ended with pizza instead of leftover stew.
discussion.example_zh: 家里讨论到最后，决定吃披萨，不吃剩炖菜。

disease.example_en: The vet isolated the hen so the disease would not reach the others.
disease.example_zh: 兽医把那只母鸡隔开，免得病传到其余的鸡身上。

dish.example_en: The potato dish from the canteen sold out before noon.
dish.example_zh: 食堂的土豆菜肴中午之前就卖完了。

distance.example_en: The distance from the dorm to the gym is about ten minutes on foot.
distance.example_zh: 从宿舍走到体育馆，距离大约是十分钟。

distribution.example_en: Ticket distribution started at the gate an hour before the concert.
distribution.example_zh: 音乐会开始前一小时，门口开始分配门票。

district.example_en: Our district finally got a swimming pool open to students on Sundays.
district.example_zh: 我们这个地区终于有了周日对学生开放的游泳池。

division.example_en: The international division of the company sits on the top floor.
division.example_zh: 公司的国际部门在顶楼办公。

doctor.example_en: The doctor wrapped my wrist and told me not to play basketball.
doctor.example_zh: 医生包好我的手腕，让我先别打篮球。

document.example_en: Save the document with your name before the computer logs you out.
document.example_zh: 在电脑退出登录之前，用你的名字把这份文件保存好。

dog.example_en: Our dog sleeps under the table whenever we eat dumplings.
dog.example_zh: 我们一吃饺子，狗就睡到桌子底下。

door.example_en: A cold wind pushed the door shut while we were carrying boxes.
door.example_zh: 我们搬箱子的时候，冷风把门带上了。

doubt.example_en: There was no doubt that her free kick would beat the keeper.
doubt.example_zh: 毫无疑问，她的任意球会打过守门员。

dozen.example_en: Mum bought a dozen bread rolls for the class picnic.
dozen.example_zh: 妈妈为班级野餐买了一打小面包。

draft.example_en: I crossed out half of my first draft and started the ending again.
draft.example_zh: 我划掉初稿的一半，结尾又重新写了一遍。

drama.example_en: The drama about a lost dog left several people in tears.
drama.example_zh: 那出关于走失小狗的戏剧让好几个人落了泪。

drawing.example_en: Her drawing of the old bridge hangs in the school entrance.
drawing.example_zh: 她的那幅旧桥图画挂在学校入口处。

dream.example_en: Flying a small plane has been his dream since a trip to the airfield.
dream.example_zh: 自从去过小型机场，开小飞机就成了他的梦想。

dress.example_en: The red dress in the window was the one she wore to the concert.
dress.example_zh: 橱窗里的那条红连衣裙，就是她去音乐会时穿的。

drink.example_en: A cold drink from the machine cost more than my bus fare.
drink.example_zh: 自动售货机里的一杯冷饮比我的车费还贵。

driver.example_en: The driver stopped the bus so a student could pick up her folder.
driver.example_zh: 司机把车停下，让一名学生捡起她的文件夹。

drug.example_en: The drug eased my sore throat, but it made me sleepy in class.
drug.example_zh: 这种药物缓解了嗓子疼，却让我上课发困。

duck.example_en: A duck led five ducklings across the path beside the boating lake.
duck.example_zh: 一只鸭子领着五只小鸭穿过划船湖边的小路。

duty.example_en: Checking the windows is my duty on the days I leave last.
duty.example_zh: 我最后离开的那些天，检查窗户是我的义务。

ear.example_en: She tucked her hair behind one ear and started the listening test.
ear.example_zh: 她把头发别到一只耳朵后面，开始做听力测试。

earth.example_en: The globe shows the earth with blue oceans and green land.
earth.example_zh: 这个地球仪上的地球有蓝色的海洋和绿色的陆地。

Easter.example_en: We hid chocolate eggs in the garden for the Easter treasure hunt.
Easter.example_zh: 我们把巧克力蛋藏在花园里，做复活节寻宝游戏。

economy.example_en: Fishing and tourism keep the economy of this coastal town alive.
economy.example_zh: 渔业和旅游业维持着这座海边小镇的经济。

edge.example_en: Do not sit on the edge of the desk or it may tip over.
edge.example_zh: 别坐在书桌边上，不然桌子可能会翻倒。

edition.example_en: The new edition of the atlas has a page on melting ice.
edition.example_zh: 这本地图册的新版本有一页讲冰层融化。

editor.example_en: The editor moved my photo to the front page of the school paper.
editor.example_zh: 编辑把我的照片放到了校报头版。

education.example_en: Free education meant my parents could stay in school until eighteen.
education.example_zh: 因为有免费教育，我父母才能一直读到十八岁。

effect.example_en: The cough syrup had little effect, so Mum called the clinic.
effect.example_zh: 止咳糖浆几乎没有效果，妈妈就给诊所打了电话。

effort.example_en: One last effort up the hill brought her level with the leader.
effort.example_zh: 上坡时的最后一次努力让她追上了领先的人。

egg.example_en: I dropped an egg on the floor and had to clean it before class.
egg.example_zh: 我把一个鸡蛋掉在地上，上课前只好收拾干净。

Egypt.example_en: The postcard from Egypt shows pyramids under a very blue sky.
Egypt.example_zh: 从埃及寄来的明信片上，金字塔衬着很蓝的天空。

election.example_en: The election for team captain will be a secret vote on Thursday.
election.example_zh: 队长选举定在星期四，采用无记名投票。

electricity.example_en: Lightning cut the electricity, and we finished dinner by torchlight.
electricity.example_zh: 闪电把电切断了，我们打着手电筒吃完了晚餐。

element.example_en: Iron is the element that makes blood able to carry oxygen.
element.example_zh: 铁这种元素让血液能够携带氧气。

employee.example_en: The new employee learned the cash register before the lunch rush.
employee.example_zh: 新雇员在午餐高峰前学会了使用收银机。

employer.example_en: Her employer let her start late on the morning of the exam.
employer.example_zh: 考试那天早上，雇主让她晚一点来上班。

employment.example_en: Holiday employment at the pool taught him to watch small children.
employment.example_zh: 在泳池的假期工作教会他照看小孩子。

end.example_en: Stay until the end, because the last scene explains the mystery.
end.example_zh: 请一直看到结束，因为最后一场才揭开谜底。

enemy.example_en: In the story the hero spares his enemy and ends the war.
enemy.example_zh: 故事里，英雄放过敌人，战争就此结束。

energy.example_en: The battery holds enough energy to run the lamp for three hours.
energy.example_zh: 这块电池的能量足够让灯亮三个小时。

engagement.example_en: They told both families about their engagement over Sunday lunch.
engagement.example_zh: 周日午饭时，他们向双方家人宣布了婚约。

engine.example_en: Smoke from the engine forced the driver to pull off the road.
engine.example_zh: 发动机冒烟，司机只好把车停到路边。

engineering.example_en: She chose engineering because she likes designing stronger bridges.
engineering.example_zh: 她选了工程学，因为她喜欢设计更结实的桥。

English.example_en: I practise English by reading the canteen menu aloud each day.
English.example_zh: 我每天朗读食堂菜单来练习英语。

enquiry.example_en: My enquiry about lost property was answered within one school day.
enquiry.example_zh: 我关于失物的询问在一个上学日内得到了回复。

enthusiasm.example_en: His enthusiasm for robots filled the club room every lunchtime.
enthusiasm.example_zh: 他对机器人的热情让社团室每个午饭时间都坐满了人。

episode.example_en: I recorded the last episode so I could watch it after training.
episode.example_zh: 我把最后一集录了下来，好在训练结束后看。

era.example_en: The museum has a room of toys from the era of black-and-white films.
era.example_zh: 博物馆有一间展室，陈列黑白电影时代的玩具。

error.example_en: An error in the timetable sent our class to the wrong room.
error.example_zh: 时间表上的一处错误让我们班走错了教室。

essay.example_en: I rewrote the essay after I noticed the conclusion did not match the question.
essay.example_zh: 我发现结论和题目对不上，就把这篇作文重写了。

establishment.example_en: The establishment of a lunchtime choir gave shy students a place to sing.
establishment.example_zh: 午间合唱团建立之后，害羞的学生有了唱歌的地方。

estate.example_en: The old estate on the hill includes a house, an orchard, and woods.
estate.example_zh: 山上那片古老的产业有房子、果园和树林。

Euro.example_en: The souvenir mug costs one Euro in the station shop.
Euro.example_zh: 车站商店里的纪念杯卖一欧元。

Europe.example_en: My uncle took the train across Europe and posted a card from each city.
Europe.example_zh: 叔叔坐火车穿越欧洲，每到一座城市就寄一张明信片。

evaluation.example_en: The coach's evaluation praised our passing but not our shooting.
evaluation.example_zh: 教练的评估表扬了传球，却没表扬射门。

evening.example_en: In the evening the streetlights come on before we reach the bridge.
evening.example_zh: 晚上，我们还没走到桥，路灯就亮了。

event.example_en: The blackout was the top event on the local evening news.
event.example_zh: 停电是当地晚间新闻的头条事件。

evidence.example_en: Footprints in the flour were evidence that the dog had been on the counter.
evidence.example_zh: 面粉上的爪印就是狗上过台面的证据。

example.example_en: Maya's rainfall graph became an example that the rest of the class copied.
example.example_zh: 玛娅的降雨统计图成了班上其他人仿照的例子。

exception.example_en: Everyone took the bus, with the exception of Jo, who lives next door.
exception.example_zh: 大家都坐了公交，只有住在隔壁的乔是例外。

exchange.example_en: Our exchange with the Japanese club included songs and handwritten letters.
exchange.example_zh: 我们和日本社团的交流包括歌曲和亲笔信。

excuse.example_en: A headache is a weak excuse for skipping the group presentation.
excuse.example_zh: 头疼算不上逃避小组展示的好借口。

executive.example_en: The executive signed the form that paid for our new lab coats.
executive.example_zh: 那位管理人员签了字，批下了新实验服的钱。

exercise.example_en: Five minutes of exercise in the yard wakes me up more than coffee does.
exercise.example_zh: 在院子里锻炼五分钟，比喝咖啡更能让我清醒。

existence.example_en: The diary proves the existence of a secret tunnel under the old school.
existence.example_zh: 这本日记证明老校舍下面存在一条秘密地道。

expectation.example_en: The sequel did not meet our expectation after the brilliant first film.
expectation.example_zh: 第一部那么精彩，续集却没有达到我们的期待。

expenditure.example_en: Family expenditure jumped when both children started music lessons.
expenditure.example_zh: 两个孩子都开始上音乐课后，家里的开支一下子增加了。

expense.example_en: The club covered the expense of the minibus for the away match.
expense.example_zh: 客场比赛的小巴费用由社团承担。

experience.example_en: Camping in the rain was a miserable experience, but we still laugh about it.
experience.example_zh: 雨中露营是一次很糟的经历，可我们现在说起来还是会笑。

experiment.example_en: Our experiment showed that plants grow faster beside a sunny window.
experiment.example_zh: 我们的实验表明，植物在向阳的窗边长得更快。

expertise.example_en: Her expertise in knots kept the sailing club safe in strong wind.
expertise.example_zh: 她打绳结的专长让帆船社在大风里仍很安全。

explanation.example_en: His explanation of the graph used one simple story about rainfall.
explanation.example_zh: 他对这张图的解释，只用了一个关于降雨的简单故事。

expression.example_en: The puzzled expression on his face showed he had missed the joke.
expression.example_zh: 他脸上困惑的表情说明他没听懂那个笑话。

extension.example_en: The referee allowed a short extension after the injury stoppage.
extension.example_zh: 受伤暂停之后，裁判允许比赛短暂延长。

extent.example_en: We did not see the full extent of the leak until we moved the fridge.
extent.example_zh: 直到挪开冰箱，我们才看清漏水的全部范围。

eye.example_en: Soap in my eye sent me running to the bathroom tap.
eye.example_zh: 肥皂进了眼睛，我跑去卫生间的水龙头边冲洗。

facility.example_en: The new sports facility lets us swim even when the outdoor pool is shut.
facility.example_zh: 有了新的体育设施，室外泳池关闭时我们也能游泳。

fact.example_en: It is a fact that sound travels faster through water than through air.
fact.example_zh: 声音在水里比在空气里传得更快，这是事实。

factory.example_en: The shoe factory by the river hires students for two weeks each summer.
factory.example_zh: 河边那家鞋厂每年夏天雇学生干两个星期。

failure.example_en: The failure of the first rocket taught the club to check the fuel.
failure.example_zh: 第一枚火箭失败之后，社团学会了先检查燃料。

faith.example_en: She kept her faith in her partner after they lost the opening set.
faith.example_zh: 首盘输掉之后，她对搭档仍然有信心。

family.example_en: Our family makes dumplings together whenever grandparents visit.
family.example_zh: 爷爷奶奶一来，我们全家就一起包饺子。

fan.example_en: A desk fan kept the exam room bearable during the heatwave.
fan.example_zh: 热浪那几天，书桌上的风扇让考场还能待得住。

farm.example_en: We collected eggs and fed the goats on my cousin's farm.
farm.example_zh: 我们在表姐的农场捡了蛋，还喂了山羊。

farmer.example_en: The farmer let our class pick strawberries if we left the small ones.
farmer.example_zh: 农民让我们班摘草莓，但小的要留下。
